adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#1

owner_calls.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
owner_calls.question: At the diner in World's End, an unnamed man (Enoch) leads a squad that freezes the whole team and takes them away. Should that group abduction count as a stage for Enoch with each team member, or stay out because he deals with nobody one to one?
options: Add a stage at S4#22 for each team member at the diner
owner_calls.evidence: World's End: Coulson's group are confronted by a mysterious man leading an armed squad; they freeze the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents and take them away. Enoch is credited.
